lines.en: Excuse me. I'm looking for a book.
Sure. Do you know the title or the author?
I read it long ago, but I forgot the author.
Let me search for it on the computer.
Thank you. Is it a book for new readers?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 처음 읽는 사람에게도 괜찮은 책이에요?

lines.en: Yes. Many readers have loved it since last year.
Which shelf is it on?
The low shelf on the left. Please walk quietly.
I will read it this week and bring it back.
Great. Ask me here if you need more information.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 정보가 더 필요하면 여기서 물어보세요.

lines.en: I finished a good book from the library yesterday.
lines.ko: 어제 도서관에서 빌린 좋은 책을 다 읽었어요.

lines.en: Oh, what is the title?
It's a true story about a kind doctor.
Who is the author? Do I know the name?
I don't remember. I will search for it tonight.
lines.ko: 기억이 안 나요. 오늘 밤에 찾아볼게요.

lines.en: I have read only three books since spring.
lines.ko: 저는 봄부터 책을 세 권밖에 못 읽었어요.

lines.en: I read quietly every night before I sleep.
lines.ko: 저는 매일 밤 자기 전에 조용히 읽어요.

lines.en: Are you a fast reader?
No, I'm slow. But I enjoyed every page last night.
lines.ko: 아니요, 느려요. 그래도 어젯밤에 모든 페이지를 즐겼어요.

lines.en: Please bring it to me. I will read it too.
